players.product: Power and distribution transformers and substations (T&D) for grid connection, plus Marathon alternators for data-center energy backup and industrial pumps / ventilation equipment for cooling systems

quarterly_data.signal: WEG supplied a complete solution for a rice-husk biomass cogeneration project at a major food industry company in Colombia (customer not named): a 7.1 MW turbogenerator (multistage condensing steam turbine with controlled extraction, speed reducer, three-phase synchronous generator, control and protection, condensation system and installation supervision) plus the plant's entire electrical package (transformers, electrical panels and a SCADA system), for on-site consumption.
